q: "I Gor to thinkin' 'bout it, days when I was sailin', and wondering if mebbe the Lord wa'n't gettin' folks ready jest the way he did the rocks-rolling 'em over and having 'em pound each other and claw and fight and cool off, slow-like, till bymeby they 'd be good sweet earth and grass and little flowers-comftabul to live with"
1906 May 26, The Publisher's Weekly, number 1791, F. Leypoldt, page 1473:
